messages.subject: Output files creation in map reduce job
parts:
Hi ,
I would like to know how to determine the number of output files to be
generated.

The parameter map.reduce.tasks if set to 0, then i think irrespective
of the size of the file it will create only one output files.

Lets say if i have 1PB of file, then i think its not worth to work
with one output file, yeah i do agree with the fact that hadoop will
split those files into blocks of data and will distribute across the
nodes.

Can you please clarify me on this thing,that how should we determine
the number of ouput files to generate.

Regards,
Sphinx

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Output files creation in map reduce job
parts:
On Thu, Dec 30, 2010 at 5:27 AM, Sphinx <hr.profe...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Hi ,
> I would like to know how to determine the number of output files to be
> generated.

If mapred.reduce.tasks=0, the number of output files is the number of
tasks as defined by the
inputformat. E.g. for a sequence file input format, it is the number
of blocks of all the input files.
So a 1GB file stored as 128MB blocks would create 8 (1GB/128MB == 8)
tasks and therefore 8 files.


if mapred.reduce.tasks >0, there will be mapred.reduce.task number of
files, though some might be empty.

Whether you need mapred.reduce.task >0 or not depends on your needs.

> nodes.
